summary:
GuaTec is a 3D educational game that puts players on the ground support team for Apollo 11. In the first playable mission, players explore a recreation of Kennedy Space Center on July 16, 1969, as a fictional technician. They inspect equipment, verify communications, and complete a series of launch readiness checks before watching the Saturn V lift off. A mission report shows what they accomplished.

For the Space Mission Design Game challenge, we focused on launch operations. The game lets students see how individual checks and teams depend on one another to get a mission ready. We used NASA historical records and photographs to ground the setting, then turned the work behind the launch into tasks players can try for themselves. The game runs in a web browser and is available in Spanish, English, and French.
details:
Mission 01 recreates the morning of July 16, 1969 at Kennedy Space Center. Players take the role of a fictional ground support technician and explore a stylized 3D reconstruction of the launch complex. A mission log, map, radio messages, and interactive stations guide them through the work leading up to liftoff. Players inspect equipment, verify communications, and prepare an observation point. They see the crew transfer and watch the Saturn V launch from a remote station. The mission closes with a historical epilogue and a report on their progress.

Our entry for Space Mission Design Game focuses on an operational phase of a real mission. Tasks build on earlier checks so students can see how different teams and systems contribute to a launch. NASA records and photographs informed the timeline, locations, and visual references. The technician, dialogue, and simplified station interactions were written for the game.

We built the 3D experience with TypeScript, Three.js, and Vite, and used Web Audio for the soundscape. A Python and Flask backend saves progress and mission results. The game runs in a desktop browser with keyboard and mouse, offers guest access, and includes a multilingual interface and subtitles.
